rows.exact_text: - **EACH module entry** must present its readable name, a clearly visible real enable/disable **toggle**, a dedicated **Help/manual** button, and an unambiguous activation-state indication. Distinguish activated/deactivated and any non-toggleable CORE or restricted module states truthfully. The user would also like visual differentiation of states by color, but **never rely on color alone**: retain state text/shape/icon for accessibility and avoid contradictory colors or stale state.
